draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Suchindram! The Thanumalayan Temple here honours Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma all at once, and its eastern tower rises 11 storeys, 44 metres high. Inside you'll also find a 22-foot Hanuman carved from a single block of granite.
draft.hungryLine: This is Tamil Nadu tiffin country, so go for idli, dosai or a crisp vada, washed down with a strong filter coffee.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Thanumalayan Temple is just a 3 min walk away. Parakkai Lake, west of town, is about 22 minutes on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk out to Parakkai Lake, 22 minutes from here, and enjoy the quiet just north of Parakkai village.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The temple counts among the 108 Shiva temples revered in Kerala's Hindu culture, even though it's now in Tamil Nadu.

spots.name: Thanumalayan Temple
spots.detail: 3 min walk · 44 m eastern gopuram and the giant granite Hanuman

spots.name: Parakkai Lake
spots.detail: 22 min walk · A peaceful lake just west of town

legends.title: Three gods, one name
legends.body: Locals will tell you the temple's name holds the whole Trimurti: Stanu for Shiva, Mal for Vishnu and Ayan for Brahma. That's why both Shaivites and Vaishnavites hold it dear.

tips.title: Visit during Margazhi.
tips.body: The Margazhi festival is the temple's biggest of the year.

tips.title: Get here by bus or road.
tips.body: No trains stop at Suchindram station, so come by bus or road from Nagercoil, 7 km away, or Kanyakumari, 11 km.

story.title: Built by the Cholas
story.body: The present stone structure of the Thanumalayan Temple went up during the Chola dynasty in the 9th century. Later rulers kept adding to it.

story.title: A Travancore citadel
story.body: Suchindram, along with Kanyakumari, was part of Travancore and served as an important citadel. That's why the temple is still tied to Kerala's temple traditions.

story.title: Joining Tamil Nadu
story.body: The town became part of Tamil Nadu when Kanyakumari District was merged in from Travancore.

story.title: A pilgrim town
story.body: Suchindram is an important pilgrim centre sitting between Nagercoil and Kanyakumari. The temple holds six daily rituals between 5:30 a.m. and 9 p.m.
